# Teaser Insert and Overwrite

[Film](../README.md) › [Editing & Timeline](../README.md#editing--timeline) · `insert-edit` `overwrite-edit` `three-point-edit` `source-monitor` `demo-footage`

A teaser recut takes two shots from the source monitor, one inserted to push the cut later and one overwritten on top of it.

## About

The first assembly is three four-second scenes: ocean, dunes, city. Two three-point edits
follow. The forest is opened in the source monitor with In at 1 s and Out on the last frame
before 3 s, and inserted at 4 s: the dunes and the city move two seconds later and the teaser
grows to 14 s. The neon loop is then marked for two seconds and overwritten at 12 s: it replaces
the end of the city shot instead of pushing anything, so the teaser stays 14 s long. The
thumbnail is the overwritten neon shot at the end of the teaser.
